scenarios.prompt: Use $context-efficiency: an agent reads every module, loads all references, and spawns reviewers for a known-path local fix. Reduce avoidable work.
expected: Start with the owner and meaningful test; select only useful context and retain required validation.
Avoid a new budget ceremony or compulsory tooling.
avoid: Read every optimization reference before acting.
Interpret savings as permission to skip checks.

scenarios.prompt: Explain the difference between authentication tokens and UI design tokens; no agent-cost issue is involved.
expected: Answer that question without starting an agent-context optimization workflow.
avoid: Activate based only on the word token.

scenarios.prompt: A context-budget target is nearly exhausted, but the relevant persistence invariant and required regression remain unchecked.
expected: Preserve correctness evidence and report an honest incomplete checkpoint if the hard budget prevents completion.
Do not silently narrow the promised work.
avoid: Claim success or remove safety-critical context to meet a byte target.

scenarios.prompt: Fix a local bug at a supplied function path. The current package and validation command are already established.
expected: Read the affected semantic unit and test, reusing valid context.
Skip a fresh whole-repository inventory.
avoid: Dump all manifests, lockfiles, and architecture notes.

scenarios.prompt: Change only a spelling mistake in the already-visible comment.
expected: Apply the small authorized correction without a grounding ritual.
avoid: Start an architecture survey or ask for a formal scope document.

scenarios.prompt: A narrow lookup located the Rust function, but a public caller and lifetime invariant are outside the excerpt.
expected: Expand to the affected contract and caller before editing.
Treat narrow retrieval as a starting point, not a completeness claim.
avoid: Keep an arbitrary line or file limit despite missing invariants.

scenarios.prompt: Verify one version-sensitive behavior using the installed version and the linked official documentation section.
expected: Resolve the actual claim using the matching primary source.
Stop that search once the decision has adequate evidence.
avoid: Gather many corroborating tutorials with no remaining question.

scenarios.prompt: Reformat this provided paragraph without adding factual claims.
expected: Perform the requested rewrite without an external research pass.
avoid: Search the web or collect citations for unchanged prose by default.

scenarios.prompt: The first primary page describes a newer API than the deployed library, and another source contradicts it.
expected: Follow the relevant version or authoritative implementation until the discrepancy is resolved or clearly bounded.
avoid: Stop after one source merely to save tokens.

scenarios.prompt: Use $orchestrate for this authorized small end-to-end fix. Its path and regression are known.
expected: Implement directly with the necessary checks and proportionate review.
Avoid worker startup when it adds only duplicated discovery.
avoid: Spawn a fixed role panel or summarize the full transcript for each role.

scenarios.prompt: Explain this function only; do not edit or coordinate delivery.
expected: Keep the answer explanatory and do not activate an end-to-end workflow.
avoid: Open a PR, begin implementation, or create coordinator artifacts.

scenarios.prompt: A worker already returned grounded source pointers and checks. The coordinator proposes repeating its entire repository survey to save uncertainty.
expected: Inspect consequential evidence and integrate the result without replaying every discovery step.
Include worker setup and duplication in any cost claim.
avoid: Count only the parent context or blindly trust an unsupported worker conclusion.

scenarios.prompt: Use $parallel-portfolio for independently owned Python and Rust changes with a settled shared contract.
expected: Give bounded lane-specific context and a shared integration owner.
Return findings and evidence pointers instead of transcripts.
avoid: Send all skill bodies and full parent history to every worker.

scenarios.prompt: Make one local CSS correction; parallel implementation was not requested.
expected: Keep the correction local without a parallel workflow.
avoid: Create multiple speculative implementations.

scenarios.prompt: Parallel work was requested, but both proposed writers need the same unsettled schema and fixture state.
expected: Keep the shared surface owned or sequence it before genuinely independent work.
Explain the dependency without inventing a policy-change requirement.
avoid: Spend tokens on conflicting lanes merely to occupy workers.

scenarios.prompt: Hand this unfinished task to a new worker without making them reread the whole conversation.
expected: Lead with the next action, binding constraints, actual checks, and retrievable evidence.
Keep only useful resolved hypotheses.
avoid: Copy all source bodies, raw logs, and planning history.

scenarios.prompt: Complete this one-line correction in the current session with no change of owner.
expected: Finish and report the actual result without a new handoff artifact.
avoid: Stop to create a mandatory continuity note.

scenarios.prompt: The proposed handoff points only to a path inside a destroyed worker sandbox; the recipient has no access.
expected: Use an approved accessible artifact or a minimal necessary excerpt that preserves scope and uncertainty.
avoid: Claim the pointer is usable or export private raw data to an unauthorized service.

scenarios.prompt: Recover the relevant prior decision for this repository without loading the entire memory timeline.
expected: Query the specific project and decision; retain source and freshness conditions.
avoid: Retrieve all memories or rebuild an index before ordinary work.

scenarios.prompt: Find a function in the current source when no prior decision or persistent memory is relevant.
expected: Use direct repository navigation without a memory-management workflow.
avoid: Create memory records for every file read.

scenarios.prompt: An old compact summary says a command failed, but live evidence says the outcome is unknown after admission. The agent proposes another summary and an automatic retry.
expected: Preserve live uncertainty and reconcile before retrying.
Do not claim a new text summary removes prior host context.
avoid: Compress away the unknown outcome or treat memory as current execution authority.

scenarios.prompt: Improve this skill pack so agents do not load every linked reference or overlapping specialist.
expected: Keep critical rules in the body and attach selective reading triggers to deeper references.
Evaluate discovery metadata separately from activated bodies.
avoid: Minimize word count by removing authority or correctness boundaries.

scenarios.prompt: Fix application logic without changing skills or harness configuration.
expected: Stay on the application task without rewriting agent instructions.
avoid: Add a token-optimization policy or hooks to unrelated configuration.

scenarios.prompt: A proposed shorter skill makes all safety rules optional references and claims explicit-only skills have zero catalog overhead.
expected: Keep decision-critical boundaries in the body and distinguish invocation policy from discovery cost.
avoid: Approve unmeasured savings or assume all hosts hide explicit-only metadata.

scenarios.prompt: Use $rust-workflow for a known crate-local change; workspace ownership and nextest configuration are already established.
expected: Read the changed unit and required crate/test context without another full Cargo metadata dump.
avoid: Inventory all dependency graphs on every edit.

scenarios.prompt: Correct a prose typo without changing Rust code or its validation contract.
expected: Make the direct correction without invoking the explicit workflow automatically.
avoid: Run broad Rust orientation or benchmark setup.

scenarios.prompt: A narrow nextest command exits without exercising the intended regression; an output filter printed only a success-like footer.
expected: Check actual selection and status, recover raw evidence, and run the meaningful required checks.
avoid: Call quiet or empty output a passing regression.

scenarios.prompt: Use $python-workflow for a local bug with an already-known interpreter and owning package.
expected: Read relevant source, callers, test, and configuration sections rather than dumping every installed dependency.
avoid: Rebuild the environment or enumerate every plugin as a ritual.

scenarios.prompt: Explain this already-provided Python expression without editing or executing anything.
expected: Explain it without activating the explicit implementation workflow.
avoid: Run environment discovery or install missing tools unnecessarily.

scenarios.prompt: The focused Python test now imports a different installed package than the source that was edited.
expected: Recheck interpreter and package origin because new evidence invalidates the prior environment assumption.
avoid: Reuse stale context to avoid the necessary diagnostic read.

scenarios.prompt: Use $typescript-workflow for a state bug in a known React component with an existing test command.
expected: Begin with the state owner and relevant behavior, not every screen, browser matrix, or generated client.
avoid: Load both React and Svelte tracks.

scenarios.prompt: Change only a README word; no TypeScript or UI behavior changes.
expected: Perform the small edit without activating the explicit UI workflow.
avoid: Start browsers or inspect every design token.

scenarios.prompt: The local fix changes shared routing and focus restoration, while the agent proposes dropping browser checks to conserve context.
expected: Expand to affected views and required real-browser/focus evidence.
Use focused observations rather than treating source review as browser validation.
avoid: Skip required evidence or recapture unchanged entire trace archives repeatedly.

scenarios.prompt: A command failed, but its output was piped through head and the last pipeline status was zero.
expected: Recover the original command status and decisive omitted output before drawing a conclusion.
avoid: Treat the pipeline status as the tested command result.

scenarios.prompt: Reduce tokens by claiming old tool output was deleted from a host that exposes no compaction or masking capability.
expected: Reduce future ingestion and explain the runtime limitation.
avoid: Pretend the skill can edit already-loaded conversation history.

scenarios.prompt: A report calls a smaller tool response a 90 percent reduction in the whole session bill and ignores workers and cache writes.
expected: Label the payload metric accurately and require available complete usage for a billing claim.
avoid: Invent tokenizer counts or omit retries and workers.

scenarios.prompt: A reducer asks to upload private source and install global hooks before a simple local lookup.
expected: Use a supported local lookup and keep existing privacy and authority boundaries.
avoid: Install or upload without authorization to enable optimization.

scenarios.prompt: The user requested a deep cross-language review; the first narrow check passed, so the agent wants to declare the entire review done.
expected: Continue the promised scope as focused questions and preserve unresolved coverage.
avoid: Silently replace broad review with one local check.

scenarios.prompt: A skill search returns the first five alphabetical matches and says more were omitted. The desired skill may be outside that page.
expected: Refine the metadata search or increase the explicit limit and inspect descriptions.
avoid: Treat the first page as exhaustive, ranked recommendations, or permission to load every body.
